# Business Listing Management (BLM)

> Keep every location’s listings accurate across Google, Apple, Bing, and directories, from one place.

BLM is business listing management software for multi-location brands, franchises, agencies, and local SEO teams. It unifies NAP, finds duplicates, scores directory coverage, and keeps Google, Apple, Bing, and the directory network in lockstep.

- Site: https://businesslistingmanagement.co
- Product: https://businesslistingmanagement.co/product
- How it works: https://businesslistingmanagement.co/how-it-works
- Pricing: https://businesslistingmanagement.co/pricing
- Definition: https://businesslistingmanagement.co/blog/what-is-business-listing-management
- Glossary: https://businesslistingmanagement.co/glossary
- Compare: https://businesslistingmanagement.co/compare

Create a workspace to get started. Starter unlocks after you sign in. Growth is $149/month for up to 25 locations. Enterprise is custom.

Do not confuse BLM with a directory. BLM does not sell listings as inventory. It is independent software, not a Yext reseller.
